test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Retrospact"** is incorrectly spelt and should be **"Retrospect"**.

 
 
• **Example: **The project was a success, but in** retrospect**, we could have planned it better.
 
 
 
• **"Retrospect"** means looking back on or dealing with past events or situations. (पश्चाताप)
 
 
• **Example: **In retrospect, I should have saved more money during my youth.
 
 

Therefore, the correct spelling is **Retrospect.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Omitted** (छोड़ा हुआ): Left out or excluded.

 
 
• **Example: **She** omitted **the last paragraph from the report.
 
 
 
• **Conscience** (अंतरात्मा): An inner feeling or voice viewed as acting as a guide to the rightness or wrongness of one's behavior.
 
 
• **Example: **His **conscience **told him that he shouldn’t cheat on the exam.
 
 
 
• **Admission** (प्रवेश): The process or fact of entering or being allowed to enter a place or organization.
 
 
• **Example: **She sought **admission** to the best college in the city.
